brand.name: Henry Clay
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full brand index. Founded in the 1840s by Spanish immigrant Julian Alvarez Granda in Cuba, named after the US statesman Henry Clay. A historic Havana brand, nationalized by Castro's government post-Revolution with production severely reduced through the 1960s. The US trademark was held separately by Henry Clay & Bock Co. Ltd. (Trenton, NJ, part of the American Tobacco Trust); by 1986 it was owned by Consolidated Cigar Corporation, which began producing non-Cuban Henry Clays. Altadis later acquired Consolidated Cigar Corp. No official Altadis USA brand/press page was found in this research pass - all positioning language is retailer paraphrase, not a verified primary-source brand statement.
brand.founded: 1840s (Cuban original); current non-Cuban Altadis-era production has no single documented relaunch date
brand.origin_country: Multiple, depending on sub-line - see individual lines
